items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Look at Bobby Plater. It's just unbelievable.

ctx.x: Black. Big Black stud. He was built like Lester -- and you know how Lester was built. He was built like that. I don't know what in the hell Lunceford went down for, a big, powerful mother like that. Right in front of the band! -- BOOM. Look at Bobby Plater. It's just unbelievable. Johnny Hodges, the calmest...I guess sometimes the calmest, would carry...
